name: smooth-physics
description: Real-time secondary motion for character rigs on the web: cloth, hair, tails, ribbons and chains on existing bones.
author: Johnny Esteban Quesada

scripts.pack: pnpm run generate:unrounded && vp pack src/index.ts src/three.ts src/float32/scalar.ts src/float32/vector.ts src/float32/quaternion.ts src/float32/matrix.ts --dts --platform neutral --target es2023
scripts.test: pnpm run generate:unrounded && vp test run --root ../..
scripts.bench:baseline: pnpm run generate:unrounded && vpx bench/run.ts --out bench/results/baseline-node.json && vpx bench/browser.ts --out bench/results/baseline-browser.json
scripts.test:performance: pnpm run generate:unrounded && vpx bench/run.ts --compare bench/results/baseline-node.json && vpx bench/browser.ts --compare bench/results/baseline-browser.json
